claims.text: The loop is: PICK a task by measurement -> attempt it in an isolated worktree (:mod:`daedalus.spine.attempt`) -> run gates -> hand a HUMAN a patch.
claims.why: References daedalus.spine.attempt, not present in this chunk.

claims.text: This module is the first and last step: it decides what is worth attempting, and it renders the review packet a human reads before deciding to promote anything.
claims.why: Claims about module's role; no functions defined in this chunk to verify.

claims.text: Every candidate carries three things and is refused without them: ``reason`` one sentence a human can disagree with, ``score`` a number, ``evidence`` the MEASUREMENT the score was computed from, as data -- the file it was read out of, the counts, the recall, the churn.
claims.why: Candidate class not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: :func:`_candidate` enforces this: a candidate with an empty reason or empty evidence raises rather than entering the queue.
claims.why: _candidate function not present in this chunk.

claims.text: A queue that can be filled with opinion is a queue that will be, and an unvalidated metric must never gate autonomy -- so the metric has to stay auditable all the way to the terminal.
claims.why: General design claim; no code in chunk to verify.
BAND and offset not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: The BAND (:data:`SOURCE_BANDS`) is the source's priority. It is a PRIOR, chosen by a human, not a measurement -- islands before stale artifacts, both before eval misses, all before hotspots.
claims.why: SOURCE_BANDS not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: It is stated here as a constant instead of being smuggled into a weighting so a reviewer can argue with it directly.
claims.why: Constant not present in this chunk.

claims.text: The OFFSET, within ``[0, BAND_SPAN]``, is the measurement: test counts and entrypoint counts for inventory features, recall shortfall for eval misses, normalised churn x complexity for hotspots.
claims.why: BAND_SPAN not defined in this chunk; offset calculation not present.

claims.text: Two candidates from the same source are ordered by evidence and nothing else.
claims.why: Ranking logic not in this chunk.

claims.text: Once a candidate has been ATTEMPTED, the ledger's record of how that attempt ended puts a CEILING on its offset (:data:`OUTCOME_POLICY`).
claims.why: OUTCOME_POLICY not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: That is still a measurement -- the loop's own return path -- and it obeys the band like every other one: memory reorders inside a priority and can never leave it.
claims.why: No code in chunk to verify.

claims.text: Cross-band comparison is therefore NOT a claim that one island beats one hotspot on evidence. It is the stated priority order.
claims.why: No band definitions in this chunk.

claims.text: Sources that require a fresh eval run or a whole-repo structural index are OFF unless asked for (``--eval``, ``--hotspots``).
claims.why: CLI flags not in this chunk.

claims.text: The default queue is built from files already on disk, so the picker stays fast enough to run before every attempt.
claims.why: Queue building logic not in this chunk.

claims.text: The honesty cost is stated at the point of use: a clean cheap eval read means 'nothing is RECORDED as missing', never 'the eval passes'.
claims.why: No code in chunk to verify.

claims.text: :func:`main` can run at most ONE attempt (``--once``), and an attempt produces inert bytes (see :class:`daedalus.spine.attempt.PatchArtifact`).
claims.why: main not defined in this chunk; references external class.

claims.why: No code in chunk to verify.
